decisions.reason: Relaxation of the muscles is explicitly defined and directly relevant to the fitness anchor; it is not general leisure or travel relaxation.
A story or set of culturally meaningful stories is fully explained and appropriate to legend study; it is not limited to an entire system in every use.
The cobra genus and jewelry meanings are unrelated to the fitness cobra pose; no taxonomic specialist is released on that homonym alone.
Household linen, especially table linen, is a clear hospitality meaning; fine quality or literary register is not required.
No exact plural source entry or reviewed naris morphology mapping is available; the plausible anatomical plural still needs recorded evidence.
The exact singular noun means a nostril and is appropriate to breathing anatomy; no clinical precision advantage is asserted.
The population-based live-birth ratio is fully defined and relevant to demography; it is not an individual's biological ability to conceive.
The swimming pool or building housing pools is explicit and fits pool vocabulary; retain the US label and do not require every instance to be indoors.
Select the buttocks meaning and retain plural-only usage; exclude the unrelated midbrain and bivalve-shell senses.
No exact sourced English entry is present; the Latin-derived sodium name and formal-register claim cannot be inferred from the old gloss.
The shirt part encircling the neck is an explicit clothing meaning suitable to work-apparel discussion; do not promote financial or exercise collar homonyms.
An ornament worn tightly around the neck is a clear jewelry meaning related to necklace; historical-only usage is not imposed.
The death-notice sense directly fits obituary in formal communications; the church register and study-of-death senses are not selected.
The candidate merely says a negatively charged elementary particle, which does not distinguish an electron from other charged particles; clearer precise evidence is required.
The aquatic plant genus is unrelated to the fitness lotus pose; botanical evidence does not establish an appropriate exercise connection.
The top-layer wording risks misrepresenting a multi-layered cortical region, while the alternative repeats another unexplained anatomical term; seek clearer factual definition.
A newborn infant or recently born baby is a complete meaning appropriate to baby vocabulary; no unsourced age boundary is added.
Abnormal new tissue growth is explicitly defined and relevant to tumor terminology; it is not automatically cancer and no diagnostic inference is made.
The joined phrase lacks exact evidence or a reviewed nerve center identity mapping; the headquarters gloss alone cannot supply a source-backed meaning.
The central-nervous-system adjective is explicitly expanded by the source and useful for anatomy; do not publish the old nerve-block procedure comparison.
The exact entry directly identifies neuron as the meaning, appropriate to academic nerve-cell vocabulary without unsupported claims about histological usage frequency.
The physiology branch dealing with the nervous system is self-contained and relevant to bodily-function study; retain usually-uncountable usage.
No exact factual entry is available for this hyphenated form; the old logic-and-computing recommendation does not verify a useful alternative to odd.
Failure to appear, especially at a trial, is explicitly defined and distinguishes attendance default from failure to pay.
Failure to attend is a direct self-contained meaning related to absence, without requiring a particular institutional setting.
The selected noun explicitly includes armed-forces members not participating in combat; publish this accurate distinction rather than equating all noncombatants with civilians.
The source only says refusal to concur and does not explain the intended legal disagreement meaning; do not infer judicial procedure from the old gloss.
The plaintiff's failure to follow up or withdrawal of a suit is explicitly defined; this vocabulary sense is not advice about procedures in any jurisdiction.
An entity holding a note such as a promissory note is a clear finance meaning; not every note has the same form as a bond.
The joined phrase lacks exact evidence and a reviewed noun class identity mapping; do not infer grammatical equivalence from the old gender gloss.
The slow short batted-ball meaning is verified but unrelated to the fitness roller-equipment anchor; preserve hidden rather than promote a sports homonym mismatch.
Rendering something void or without effect is fully explained and relevant to cancellation; exclude the specific historical controversy and body-modification sense.
The obstetric pregnancy-history term is unrelated to business parity, and the source does not match the old live-birth-only gloss; keep the specialist hidden.
The only entry repeats nurtures without explaining caregiving; the intended relationship to parenting needs a self-contained factual meaning.
A small nut is a complete food-category meaning related to nut; exclude the narrower botanical ovary-section sense.
The edible portion of a nut is explicitly defined and relevant to food preparation; retain the US usage label.
The source explicitly says believed to have curative properties, describing a product category rather than proving efficacy; not every vitamin has medicinal benefits.
Nourishing or providing nutrition is a complete meaning directly relevant to nutritional properties without making product-specific health claims.
The party owed an obligation is fully explained and useful in legal business vocabulary; obligations are not restricted to money debts.
The party bearing a legal obligation is explicit and complementary to obligee; a borrower or debtor is only one possible case.
